set.body:
Outcome: revise the current plan in place so that, after the scene-level scientific preview, the next milestone is a detail-level recall-to-film mapping (recall detail inventory, a slim source cast/row record, graded fidelity binding, derived coverage/omission, an order-independent condition), each delivered as an additive field set in the same bundle and qualified against human coding.
Scope: docs only (ROADMAP.md, the 2026-11-09 working plan, a new dated plan) plus Mote epic and children. No source, build or ADR change; ADR for new vocabulary is an open owner decision.
Acceptance: ROADMAP and working plan point to one revision; every new milestone has one observable exit; Mote epic and children exist with dependencies; branch pushed for owner review.
Requested by the owner in chat 2026-11-16 ("how would you alter extant plan? ... update the plan in place").
set.title: Plan revision 2026-11-16: detail-level mapping after the scene preview
